definitions.explanation: A shop that specializes in selling fresh meat. {精肉|せいにく} refers to dressed meat (meat that has been cut and prepared for sale), and {店|てん} means shop.

examples.japanese: {精肉店|せいにくてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{牛肉|ぎゅうにく}→牛肉：02874_gyuuniku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought beef at the butcher shop.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{精肉店|せいにくてん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コロッケ→コロッケ：10857_korokke⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧だ。
examples.english: The croquettes at this butcher shop are famous.

examples.japanese: ⟦{商店街|しょうてんがい}→商店街：09391_shoutengai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{精肉店|せいにくてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}→注文：03485_chuumon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}わせて→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}って→切る：02693_kiru⟧⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: At the butcher shop in the shopping street, they cut the meat to order.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{精肉|せいにく}→精肉：14826_seiniku⟧ (dressed meat; butchered meat) and ⟦{店|てん}→店：10011_ten⟧ (shop). Traditional butcher shops in Japanese shopping streets (⟦{商店街|しょうてんがい}→商店街：09391_shoutengai⟧) often also sell prepared items like ⟦コロッケ→コロッケ：10857_korokke⟧ (croquettes) and ⟦メンチカツ→メンチカツ：15300_menchikatsu⟧ (minced meat cutlets), which are popular take-out snacks.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {精肉店|せいにくてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to buy at a butcher shop
- {精肉店|せいにくてん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コロッケ→コロッケ：10857_korokke⟧: butcher shop croquettes
- ⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{精肉店|せいにくてん}: the local butcher shop

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{肉屋|にくや}→肉屋：15233_nikuya⟧: butcher; meat shop — more colloquial and commonly used in everyday speech
- ⟦{鮮魚店|せんぎょてん}→鮮魚店：25717_sengyoten⟧: fish shop — the equivalent for seafood
- ⟦{八百屋|やおや}→八百屋：02978_yaoya⟧: greengrocer — vegetable and fruit shop in a shopping street
